I used to sprint through the years like the finish was a prize
Skipping breakfast, skipping birthdays, skipping blinks of my eyes
Had a watch that cost a car and never knew the time
Had a calendar so full it should have been a crime
Now I take the long way, let the engine tick
I've got nowhere to be and I'm getting there quick
They said "what happened to the hunger?" and I said "I ate"

My phone says I averaged nine hours on a screen
My doctor says my numbers are the worst he's ever seen
My daughter drew a picture of the back of my head
So I put it on the fridge and then I went to bed
Woke up with the sun like a thing that people do
Made a breakfast with a vegetable, maybe even two
I'm not saying I'm enlightened, I'm not saying I'm reformed

producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 104 BPM, 4/4, E-flat minor. Heavy, mechanical and grand, like a factory floor with stadium lights.

VOICE: A male rapper with a confident, conversational, slightly boastful tone that warms up as the song goes on. A vocoder voice, robotic and flat, chants the four words. The two are layered on the hook. A choir pad joins at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: Massive detuned saw-wave synth chords. A pounding, distorted kick drum and a huge snare. A buzzing synth bass. The vocoder used as an instrument. A string section in the bridge. A filtered, chopped synth arpeggio. No guitars.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the vocoder alone, then the synth chords. 0:18 Hook 1 with drums. 0:41 Verse 1. 1:04 Hook 2. 1:27 Verse 2. 1:50 Bridge, the beat drops and the vocoder speaks over strings, ending on a dry joke. 2:13 Verse 3 in half time. 2:36 Final hook, biggest, twice through. 3:22 Outro, the vocoder alone, slowing down and dropping in pitch like a machine switching off at 3:40.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2000s electro hip-hop: enormous, bright and compressed, synths wide, drums distorted and central, rap vocal dry.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The vocoder chanting the four words alone in the first four seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The whole song is the modern point of view. The 2007 creed was harder, better, faster. This is what the same person says after the doctor's numbers and the drawing on the fridge.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Swagger, a turn, plain honesty, contentment.
